title: Console first screen: about six serial API round trips (bundle before the first call, chained boot calls, lazy chunks before data, me/localization sent twice) make a hosted page take 2-3.5 s locally and 9-10 s on staging
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ① a measured defect from step 1 of objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 (p1, maintainer-ruled grade: 「体验相关的优先级也要提升」). A page in a hosted environment takes 9–10 s to open fully. The chain lives in the framework console, not in cloud. Reader: the `domain:ui` lane; the objectstack fleet dispatches its own cards. Dedupe: `console first screen serial`, `bootstrap waterfall`, `lazy chunk before data`, `get-session after localization`, `me/localization twice` — no open card. objectstack#34207, #34208 and #34211 (the footer count probe, the explain probes, the deployment notice) have landed and are gone from the chain.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 (its step 2 waits on this card).

## Measured

Cloud main `8431db621`, objectstack pin `1aac465fe1d0`. Local prod-like stack in the hosted posture, a plain owner of a free-plan environment, Playwright Chromium with a cold context per run and a warm server, `X-OS-Debug-Timing`.
- Setup overview: 2.2–3.4 s to the last API answer, 25 requests, 10–12 serial hops. Users list: 2.4–2.8 s, 28 requests, 9–13 hops. Environment home: 1.6 s.
- Server runtime along the critical chain is only 0.36–0.73 s. For more than half of each page's span no API request is in flight.
- The chain behaves like about six serial round trips: +150 ms of API round trip adds about 0.9 s to the page, and +300 ms adds about 1.8 s. Staging and production sit far from the user, which is how 2–3 s locally becomes 9–10 s there.

## Items (one family card)

1. **The bundle before the first call.** The first authenticated call waits 580–750 ms for the eager console bundle: 8 files, 2.92 MB raw / 751 KB br.
2. **Serial boot calls.** runtime/config + discovery → me/localization → get-session → permissions / org / meta/app → meta/app/ID/bundle → packages → ai/agents → a lazy chunk → meta/view + data → meta/position → position and permission-set data. get-session waits for me/localization; bundle, packages and ai/agents run one after another before the view and data calls.
3. **Lazy chunks before data.** Gaps of 100–490 ms where a lazy chunk loads before the view and data calls start. The data calls could start beside the chunk.
4. **Duplicate.** `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` is sent twice: at layer 2, and again beside meta/object after the app loads.

## Done when

A hosted page's critical path is at most about 3 round trips after the shell loads: the independent boot calls go in parallel and data starts beside the lazy chunk. me/localization is sent once. A test or reading pins the hop count.
